translations.translatedText: # Radio Clear News Monday 17.7.2023
Cooperation between government parties. Muslims in Finland. South Korea floods. Youth European Championships. Hot in the world, cool in Finland.
## Cooperation between government parties

![Prime Minister Petteri Orpo (National Coalition) and Finance Minister Riikka Purra (Finns Party) answered media questions at Kesäranta in Helsinki on 12 July 2023.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5000,h_2812,x_0,y_244/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-114155364ae9c4753e30/1689165147)
Open image viewer
Riikka Purra and Petteri Orpo. Photo: Silja Viitala / Yle
Cooperation between the government parties is going badly. The reason is the old racist speeches and writings of the Finns Party's ministers.
Relations between the parties worsened further last week, when the old writings of the Finns Party chair Riikka Purra became known to everyone. The writings are racist.
Purra has apologised for the writings, but the writings have made cooperation between the government parties difficult. In particular, relations between the Finns Party and RKP are now bad.
The National Coalition chair and prime minister Petteri Orpo said on Monday that the chairs of the government parties have discussed the situation, and the discussions will continue this week.
In public, Orpo has said that the government is working against racism.
## Muslims in Finland

![Friday prayer at the mosque of the Islamic Community of Finland in Helsinki.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5460,h_3071,x_0,y_173/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-105202163a417fb954d4/1671699443)
Open image viewer
The mosque of the Islamic Community of Finland in Helsinki. Photo: Antti Kolppo / Yle
Muslims in Finland demand action from the government against racism.
Islamic communities and organisations in Finland say that the government must act against hate speech and racist thinking.
26 Islamic communities and organisations wrote about the matter to Prime Minister Petteri Orpo and the whole government.
## South Korea floods

![People in protective clothing in a line in the water on a road taken over by the flood, in front of a car tunnel.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3995,h_2247,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-114329564b37b8cf2846/1689484480)
Open image viewer
Rescuers at work in the flood area in South Korea. Photo: AFP
There is heavy rain in South Korea. The rain has continued for 9 days already.
The rains have caused floods and landslides. Because of them at least 40 people have died.
The rain has also destroyed homes and cut off electricity. More than 10,000 people have been taken to safety.
## Youth European Championships

![Eight Finnish athletes pose with youth European medals in Espoo.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4211,h_2368,x_0,y_134/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-114344064b440c67c53e/1726554636)
Open image viewer
Finland's young European medallists. Photo: Tomi Hänninen/Chilipictures
Finland's young people have done well in athletics.
In the European Championships for under-23s, Finland won 10 medals. Among them were 3 gold medals, that is, 3 Finns won a European title.
The Finnish European champions are hammer thrower Silja Kosonen, heptathlete Saga Vanninen and pole vaulter Juho Alasaari.
The athletics youth European Championships were held this time in Finland, in Espoo.
## Hot in the world
![People on a beach in Qingdao in China.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4000,h_2250,x_0,y_278/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-113981064a80187c67d3/1688732121)
Open image viewer
Chinese people are suffering from the heat. Photo: AOP
Hot weather continues in various parts of the world.
A new heat record was measured in China on Sunday. The temperature was 52.2 degrees. It was measured in Xinjiang province.
## Cool in Finland
![Tuesday's weather map.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1919,h_1080,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-114385864b5683abcf59/1689610324)
Open image viewer
The weather in Finland is rainy. Thunder rumbles at times all over the country. The thunderstorms may be strong.
Temperatures are about 20 degrees in the south. In the north it is 15–20 degrees.
Cool and rainy weather continues for almost the whole week.
